capability: Any colours, but the reading pair stays pinned
title: Keep the reading pair pinned.

hook.picture: Close on the whale painting the line in soft pastel cards. The words written on the line fade into the paper as each card goes down.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The brand colours are gorgeous. Nobody can read the slides.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: each new brand colour arrives and the text colour is picked again by eye. Three times, faster, and each time the words get fainter.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: New colours arrive. The words get fainter.

stakes.body: Leaders present to a room that can't read the screen, and the message is lost.

solution_hint: Pin the reading pair. Check it every time.

metaphor.body: Two pins hold the ink and the paper apart. Every colour set passes a gate that checks ink against paper, so the colours can change while the words stay sharp.

steps.picture: Two pins drop: one fixes the paper tone, one fixes the ink tone. They sit at either end of the line.
steps.sound: Two tuned plucks, low and high.

steps.picture: The whale swaps colour sets wildly. Each set passes a gate that measures ink against paper and glows. The words stay crisp.
steps.words: Change any colour. The words stay sharp.
steps.sound: Plucks with varied brightness, always in tune.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale tries a pastel ink. The gate closes on it with a copper flag. The whale picks a darker ink and the gate glows.
steps.words: Too faint to read? It never ships.
steps.sound: Sour clunk on the stop, clean click on the pass.

steps.picture: A tick lands for the pass.

real_case.claim: The studio's Wada engine holds 348 colour combinations (Haishoku Soukan, 1933) and enforces WCAG AAA ink-on-paper contrast, with the lowest reported pair at 7.65:1.

source.title: CETI Motion Atlas Studio Pro README (gates G01-G02)

honest_limit.picture: A slide passes the reading-pair gate with crisp words, but two of its chart colours are the same grey to the pod. The contrast check never looked at them.
honest_limit.words: Readable words. Two chart colours look the same.

not_this.body: Readable is not the same as clear.

ending_pattern.body: The FELT shot returns: bold new colours, the pins hold, and the back-row pod reads the slide and answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same back-row pod that squinted in bar 2 now reads the slide.

end_belief.body: Pick any colours. Pin the reading pair.

beats.picture: Close: the whale lays soft pastel cards along the line, admiring each one. The words on the line grow paler with every card.
beats.sound: Soft brushed pad, a little sour.

beats.picture: A pod in the back row squints at the line and answers with a copper ✕ chip.
beats.words: Nobody in the back row could read it.

beats.picture: The whale adds a brighter pastel. The words almost disappear.
The whale looks at the back-row pod. Hold.
beats.camera: Close z 1.7, hold on the whale's face

beats.picture: Half a bar of stillness, then the title.
beats.camera: Still z 1.6, half bar of stillness

beats.picture: Pull back: a wall of past decks. Each new colour set brings a text colour picked by eye.
beats.words: New colours arrive. The words get fainter.
beats.sound: Problem motif: two notes sliding too close together.

beats.picture: Three new colour sets drop in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half. Each time the words fade more.
Motion stops. Two hollow pins ghost in at the ink and paper.
beats.words: Pin the reading pair. Check it every time.
beats.sound: Two clean notes a fifth apart.

Wide: a long stream of old colour sets flows toward the gate. Each is paired with the nearest house colour and passes with a glow.

beats.picture: The gate's bar is drawn as a line at seven to one. Nothing slips under it.
beats.words: The bar is set at seven to one.

beats.words: Readable words. Two chart colours look the same.
beats.sound: The two-note figure plays once, unresolved.

beats.picture: Slow push to the two grey chart bars.
beats.camera: One slow push to the thing that slipped

beats.picture: FELT framing: the whale lays bold new brand cards on the line. The pins hold and the words stay crisp.
beats.camera: Close z 1.6, the FELT framing restored

The pinned pair on the line, the whale breathing.

score_self.reason: Very clear pain for leaders, and the pin maps well to a fixed pair. The case numbers are real but self-reported. The limit, chart colours alike, is honest but needs a clear picture.
